missions.title: Build a modern AI SaaS landing page for “FlowBoard” — a collaborative project ma
missions.goal: Build a modern AI SaaS landing page for “FlowBoard” — a collaborative project management platform for startups. Create a beautiful homepage with a glassmorphism design, dark theme, animated hero section, pricing cards, testimonials, FAQ, responsive navigation, authentication pages, dashboard layout, and reusable React components. Generate production-ready code using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui. Ensure accessibility, smooth animations, and clean component architecture.
missions.summary:
{
  "approved": false,
  "qualityScore": 5,
  "summary": "Only a duplicate global error file was created; none of the required landing page components, UI, navigation, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, authentication pages, dashboard, or reusable components were implemented. The work is far from fulfilling the mission.",
  "issues": [
    "Missing homepage with glassmorphism design, dark theme, animated hero section.",
    "No pricing cards, testimonials, FAQ, responsive navigation, authentication pages, or dashboard layout.",
    "No reusable React components, Tailwind CSS styling, or shadcn/ui integration.",
    "Duplicate file entry indicates possible copy‑paste error; no functional code beyond a stub error handler.",
    "No TypeScript types, accessibility considerations, or animation implementations.",
    "Project structure incomplete; essential directories (components, pages, styles) absent."
  ],
  "recommendations": [
    "Start by scaffolding a Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS project with shadcn/ui.",
    "Implement the landing page layout: hero section with glassmorphism card, navigation bar, features, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, and CTA.",
    "Create reusable UI components (Button, Card, Input, Modal, etc.) using shadcn/ui primitives and extend with custom variants.",
    "Add authentication pages (sign‑in, sign‑up) using NextAuth or a mock flow, and a protected dashboard layout.",
    "Ensure responsiveness, accessibility (ARIA labels, keyboard navigation), and smooth animations (Framer Motion or CSS transitions).",
    "Write unit/storybook tests for components and perform linting/formatting (ESLint, Prettier).",
    "Commit incremental progress and verify each section against the mission checklist before moving on."
  ]
}
